verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS changelog and notification tool, so headless or CI automation (for example, publishing posts programmatically) is a fair axis. The only support is a single homepage mention that an API exists. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, no API markdown docs and no llms.txt, and the product is positioned as no-code. Missing for 10: documented API reference, CLI or CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action), auth/token docs for non-interactive use, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Find 3,000+ available integrations, API and Webhooks
